summary: Guardian Metal Resources PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the discovery of the 'Tremor Zone', a newly identified tungsten-skarn zone at its 100%-owned Pilot Mountain Tungsten Project in Nevada. The release details drill results (e.g., 13.68m at 0.31% WO3) and notes the Pre-Feasibility Study is nearing completion with a $6.2m Defense Production Act investment. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No terms of a transaction are stated, and the filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other special-situation category.
